prompt: Asset: one standalone pixel-art VFX emblem for a 32px dungeon game, transparent background. A pair of compact symmetrical SILVER KNIGHT WINGS spread to left and right, and ONE tiny silver three-point knight crown floating at upper center. Noel silver knight theme, not angel character. Entire center below crown MUST BE EMPTY transparent, rectangular gap wide enough for a 24px-wide 32px-tall character: wings only on flanks, crown only above. No central shield, no enclosing shield frame, no circular ring, no body, no person, no text, no weapon. Pixel art with strong stepped outlines, silver-white feathers with pale cyan shadow and charcoal outlines, two tiny white sparkle pixels at tips, restrained tiny gold crown accents. Flat crisp low-resolution sprite designed on a64x48 pixel grid enlarged nearest-neighbor. Wings should read as feathered silver armor, 3 chunky feather segments per side. Compact horizontal silhouette, no huge aura, no glow, no gradients, no blur. This is stronger tier5 knight transformation VFX, visually distinct from a shield-shaped supply delivery flash.
